product_metadata.title: 11" Premium Silicone Splatter Screen with Folding Handle, Heat Insulation Cooling Mat, Heat Resistant Pan Cover/Strainer, Protects Skin from Burns - Splatter Guard for Cooking and Frying
features: 【HIGH QUALITY AND SAFETY】 The Splatter Screen is made of high quality silicone and 304 stainless steel, completely BPA FREE. The splatter guard fits all your pots, skillets and pans for protecting your hand and face. And the handle is covered with silicone for extra protection!
【MULTIFUNCTION】 This multipurpose kitchen tool also doubles as a strainer, steamer, and a cooling rack, stops 99% of splash, lets all the steam out and allows you to watch the cooking process easily.

【NO MORE HOT OIL SPLASHES】 This silicone splatter cover with folding handle helps you in avoiding getting splattered and burned by sizzling oil, boiling hot sauce, or other liquids during cooking. Its special design will prevent any splashes while letting steam pass freely through.
【HEAT RESISTANT 】 The splatter guard can withstand temperature of -104℉ to 446℉ (-40℃ to 230℃), safe for use in the oven, freezer and dishwasher.
【NON-STICK AND EASY TO CLEAN 】The silicone splatter screen is not stick and very easy to clean up. Wash it in the water with dish soap or just throw it in the dishwasher.
